text_block_list.text:
You have brilliantly won the target race! 
Taking this into account, you and <chrname> discuss 
the next objective—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the next target race was decided! 
Stacking up training day after day, let's 
aim for a brand-new victory!
